paths.path: xenia.config.toml in the Xenia executable directory; portable.txt enables portable data/config layout
paths.naming: TOML settings use key = value syntax; per-game overrides are config/<title>.config.toml when explicitly selected

paths.path: SDL GameControllerDB file supplied through SDL.mappings_file (default gamecontrollerdb.txt); optional Xenia keyboard bindings remain source-defined
paths.naming: Each mapping is the exact SDL CSV grammar GUID,name,field:value,...; GUID is measured from the same SDL runtime and matching entries replace by GUID.
